Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Other Sports Antonelli becomes youngest F1 champion at 20 years old Source : Reuters 1 November 2026 10:37pm Audio By Carbonatix
Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli became Formula One's youngest world champion at ‌20 on Sunday, in a red-flagged, ​restarted Mexico City Grand Prix won by Red Bull's Max Verstappen.
The first ​Italian champion since 1953 finished ​third, sobbing with joy over the team radio as he ​took the chequered flag ​at the high-altitude Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez, ‌with ⁠his overall lead now an unassailable 119 points.
Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton started from ​pole position ​and ⁠took a close second place on an ​afternoon of drama ​with ⁠two safety cars, multiple crashes and an agonising ⁠33-minute ​halt with 25 ​of the 71 laps remaining.
